positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
• Develops and maintains internal tools and web applications to support high-volume commercial printing and distribution workflows, automating order batching and reporting for large-scale operations across the production pipeline
• Modernizes legacy Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) systems by integrating industry-standard frameworks (Node.js, React, TypeScript, Electron, and AWS), reducing technical debt and improving scalability for internal and customer-facing applications

positions.title: Technology Services Support
positions.description:
• Led the development of a Python-based file preparation tool, automating CSV sorting, image collation, and data population, maintaining full data integrity and enabling the introduction of a new product line
• Addressed data loss concerns by creating a directory copier for Windows machines using Python and GUI library Tkinter, shortening the data-loss prevention process from 30 to 5 minutes of manual work (-83.33%)
• Communicated complex technical concepts to non-technical field personnel in high-pressure situations, ensuring smooth operations and quick resolution of critical issues

positions.title: Freelance Web Developer
positions.description:
• Developed low-code web solutions for business owners to meet financial goals and improve business operations
• Built a membership website, with user registration and payment gateway functionalities, that could stream videos and gained over 50 sign-ups and increased sponsorships within a month of launch
• Created and managed an online learning management and membership website with over 100 episodes of training, improving the efficiency and participation of a life insurance sales team
positions.insights: Customer Satisfaction, Problem Solving and +3 skills

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Contributed to the open-source backend-as-a-service project ”Appwrite” by collaborating with core maintainers and two other interns to increase Appwrite’s backend functionalities for 150k+ users
• Developed a cloud function using Docker and Kotlin to send messages to end-users across four platforms, improving communication between applications and end-users
• Integrated a cloud storage adapter for Microsoft Azure’s Blob storage using PHP, REST APIs, and an extensive unit test suite, extending Appwrite’s storage capacity for unstructured storage

positions.title: Software Engineer Micro-Internship Intern
positions.description:
• Contributed to freeCodeCamp’s open-source project ”Chapter” to make it easier for non-profit organizations to create self-hosted event-management systems
• Improved the user interface for accessing different pages associated to a component of the application, making it easier for users to manage events and navigate the interface effective
• Utilized the Chakra UI library with React.js and Typescript to create a user-focused and intuitive design in a 4-week sprint, following the existing code base's design requirements and style
